scientific_integrity: Proof uses analytic global reduction and exhaustive exact rational parameter-dependent branch enumeration; computational verification covers every algebraic branch word but does not independently certify the analytic reduction. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the primitive four-cycle census of the normalized m=2 finite-step max-plus map for 3/2<t<2; no global attractor or higher-period assertion, and no classical Floquet derivative at t=5/3. Literature priority remains subject to earlier or inaccessible treatments, particularly the 2015 precursor.
title: Exact four-cycle locking boundary in a max-plus negative-feedback map
